analysis: Only CHANGELOG.md changed: a new 'Unreleased - per-model MTP acceptance opt-in' entry (patch @@ -1,4 +1,8 @@, head lines ~3-5). It describes a behaviour change: typical MTP acceptance becomes per-model opt-in with an exact default. It retires the global [backend] mtp_acceptance key, which still parses but selects nothing and logs a startup warning. Slots that cannot honour typical fall back to exact, log a warning, and report exact in slot posture telemetry. The benchmark-only DARKBLOOM_MTP_ACCEPTANCE override is unchanged. This is documentation only; no code, config or auth/encryption paths are in the supplied diff, so the actual implementation was not reviewed. Relevant threat context: the change moves sampled output back toward distribution-exact decoding, which is relevant to T-007 (manipulated provider output). It does not touch the T-041 cache, attestation, App Attest, billing or coordinator boundaries. The base text (units 2 and 3) was reviewed and carries no new security claims needing correction. No threat-model update is required from the text alone. If the code PR adds a config parser, the next pass should check that the per-model map handling and the warning logging do not leak sensitive data.
